name: Job Board (sample)
description: A stand-in job board: reads the postings bundled with it, never the network, and reports the ones that match.

salaryMin.description: Lowest annual salary wanted. A posting whose stated annual range is wholly below it is skipped; one that states no annual salary is kept.

salaryMax.description: Highest annual salary to look at. A posting whose stated annual range is wholly above it is skipped.

hourlyMin.description: Lowest hourly rate wanted. A posting whose stated hourly range is wholly below it is skipped; one that states no hourly rate is kept.

hourlyMax.description: Highest hourly rate to look at. A posting whose stated hourly range is wholly above it is skipped.

archiveAfterDays.description: Skip a posting posted more than this many days ago. A posting with no posted date is kept. Unset keeps every posting.

keywords.description: A posting matches when its title holds one of these words. Empty matches every posting.

sources.description: The boards this member may read. Empty reads none. adzuna, usajobs and themuse each need their keys set on the Host.

adzunaAppId.description: Your Adzuna application id, from developer.adzuna.com. Needed to read Adzuna.

adzunaAppKey.description: Your Adzuna application key, from developer.adzuna.com. Needed to read Adzuna.

usajobsApiKey.description: Your USAJOBS API key, from developer.usajobs.gov. Needed to read USAJOBS.

usajobsUserAgent.description: The email address you registered the USAJOBS key with; USAJOBS asks for it on every request.

themuseApiKey.description: Your The Muse API key, from themuse.com/developers. Needed to read The Muse.

publishes.summary: A posting matched the keywords for the first time. Once per new posting.

fields.name: id
fields.summary: The posting's id, and its document id in the tracker's jobs collection.
